response.evidence: Under the Continuous Deployment tab, find the Build hooks section and click on Add build hook.
response.rationale: The Netlify steps list: (1) Go to your site dashboard and click on Build & deploy; (2) Under the Continuous Deployment tab, find the Build hooks section and click on Add build hook; (3) Provide a name for your webhook and select the branch. The step immediately before naming the webhook is adding a build hook in the continuous deployment settings. 'Opening the Git tab' belongs to the Vercel steps, and copying the generated URL comes after naming the webhook.
